profile: Unmodified official MCP entry point with core plus docx,pdf,pptx,xlsx extras. Audio, cloud, LLM, YouTube and plugin extras are excluded.

metadata_overrides.reason: Constrained local document profile; official wrapper code unchanged, audio/cloud/LLM/YouTube/plugin extras excluded.

launch_policy: python -S -P -B -m markitdown_mcp with an explicit private PYTHONPATH; no .pth hooks, user site or working-directory imports. PYTHON_DOTENV_DISABLED=1 prevents project .env loading; plugins are disabled.

notice_gaps.gap: The pinned README declares BSD-2-Clause, but the wheel and tagged source provide no standalone copyright/license notice; no author copyright text has been invented.

limits: This is a constrained profile, not the all-extras dependency graph declared by markitdown-mcp.
Only pinned prebuilt wheels are unpacked; no pip/uv, build backends, shell hooks or dependency resolution run during setup or serving.
Magika includes a local ONNX file-type classifier; no model download or external model service is configured.
Native execution evidence is platform-specific and separate from static wheel/metadata/hash validation.
Windows ARM64 has no compatible ONNX Runtime <=1.20.1 wheel required by Magika 0.6.3. Windows x64 remains unavailable pending a reviewed pywin32 startup path and native acceptance tests.
The inventory retains notices published in wheel distributions and exact-source recoveries. It does not attest every statically linked library inside native wheels beyond those published notices.

local_model.name: standard_v3_3
local_model.role: Local file-type classification only; not an LLM or document-content inference service.
